section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因培养装置，包括箱体以及设置在箱体底部的支撑底座，所述箱体一侧设置有箱门，所述箱体顶部两侧均设置有鼓风组件，所述箱体顶部内壁两侧均设置有布风板，所述布风板内部设置为空腔，所述布风板底部开设有若干透气开口，所述箱体内侧底部偏上位置设置有隔板，所述隔板顶部中间位置设置有转轴。本实用新型通过拨动拨动盘即可实现对于转盘顶部不同位置的培养皿进行拿取，进而方便了装置的使用，也减少转盘其他位置的培养皿受到外部的污染，进而减少外部原因对于试验结果造成影响，同时通过打开消毒灯管以及鼓风机对装置内部进行消毒以及干燥，也保证了装置进行再次使用时的效果。

The utility model discloses a biological gene culture apparatus, including box and the support base of setting in the bottom half, box one side is provided with the chamber door, box top both sides all are provided with the blast air subassembly, box top inner wall both sides all are provided with the grid plate, the inside cavity that sets up of grid plate, a plurality of ventilative openings have been seted up to the grid plate bottom, the inboard bottom position on the upper side of box is provided with the baffle, baffle top intermediate position is provided with the pivot. The utility model discloses a stir the dial and can realize taking to the culture dish of the different positions in carousel top promptly, and then made things convenient for the use of device, also reduced the culture dish of other positions of carousel and received outside pollution, and then reduce the influence that causes to the test result of outside reason, disinfect and dry the device inside through opening disinfection fluorescent tube and air-blower simultaneously, also guaranteed the effect when the device carries out reuse.

Biological gene culture deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological gene is cultivateed with equipment correlation field, specifically is a biological gene culture apparatus.

Background

The gene engineering is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, and is based on the theory of molecular genetics, and by means of modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology, genes from different sources are constructed into hybrid DNA molecules in vitro according to a pre-designed blueprint, and then the hybrid DNA molecules are introduced into living cells to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products, and when the biological genes are tested, the biological genes are cultured by using a culture device.

However, the inside plug-type structure that all adopts of current biological gene culture device bears the dish to install the culture dish, and the setting of this kind of structure all needs to bear the dish and pull out completely when the user needs to take the culture dish of different positions, not only leads to the convenience of device lower, and can lead to bearing the culture dish that the dish outside receives the pollution easily, and then causes the influence to the test result.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biological gene culture apparatus, it all adopts plug-type structure to bear the dish to install to the culture dish to have solved current biological gene culture apparatus inside, the setting of this kind of structure, when the user need take the culture dish of different positions, all need will bear the dish and pull out completely, not only lead to the convenience of device lower, and can lead to bearing the culture dish in the dish outside and receive the pollution easily, and then cause the problem of influence to the test result.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a biological gene culture device comprises a box body and a supporting base arranged at the bottom of the box body, wherein one side of the box body is provided with a box door, both sides of the top of the box body are provided with air blast components, both sides of the inner wall of the top of the box body are provided with air distribution plates, the interior of the air distribution plate is provided with a cavity, the bottom of the air distribution plate is provided with a plurality of air-permeable openings, a baffle plate is arranged at the upper position of the bottom of the inner side of the box body, a rotating shaft is arranged in the middle of the top of the clapboard, the top of the rotating shaft is connected with the inner wall of the top of the box body through a bearing, a turntable is arranged outside the rotating shaft, a driving shaft is arranged at the bottom of the partition plate, the top of the driving shaft is connected with the bottom of the rotating shaft through a coupler, the drive shaft bottom is connected with the inner wall of the box bottom through a bearing, a poking disc is arranged at the middle position of the drive shaft, and one side of the poking disc penetrates through the outer wall of the box body.

Preferably, the box door is arranged at the top of the partition plate, an observation window is arranged in the middle of the box door, and an opening handle is arranged on one side of the box door.

Preferably, the inner wall of the box body is provided with mounting plates on both sides, one side of the mounting plates, which is far away from the inner wall of the box body, is fixedly connected with a disinfection lamp tube, and the disinfection lamp tube is an ultraviolet lamp tube.

Preferably, the air outlets are formed in the upper positions of the bottoms of the two sides of the box body and are arranged at the tops of the partition plates, an exhaust pipeline is connected to one side of each air outlet, and a first control valve is arranged inside each exhaust pipeline.

Preferably, it is two sets of the air-blast subassembly is by air-blower, tuber pipe, dry piece and second control flap, the air-blower bottom with box top fixed connection, tuber pipe one end with the air-blower air-out end is connected, the tuber pipe other end run through the box with the grid plate top is connected, dry piece with second control flap all sets up inside the tuber pipe, just dry piece sets up inside the tuber pipe is close to air-blower one side, dry piece is inside to adopt the active carbon as filling.

Preferably, the carousel is provided with the multiunit, the multiunit the carousel intermediate position all be provided with pivot assorted through-hole, and the multiunit the carousel all through the through-hole with the pivot outer wall is connected, and the multiunit the carousel is kept away from pivot one side and all is provided with the culture dish standing groove, a plurality of sets of ventilative through-holes have all been seted up to culture dish standing groove bottom, just ventilative through-hole all runs through the carousel.

The utility model provides a biological gene culture apparatus, possess following beneficial effect:

(1) the utility model discloses a set up dial plate, the drive shaft, the apparatus further comprises a rotating shaft, the carousel, when using, the user can dial plate through rotating, and then under the drive of dial plate, make the drive shaft can drive the pivot and rotate, and then under the drive effect of pivot, make the user can take the culture dish of the culture dish standing groove inside of the different positions in carousel top according to the needs of self, and needn't take out whole carousel, and then made things convenient for the use of device, and the culture dish of having avoided other positions of carousel department receives the pollution, and then reduce the influence that causes the test result of external reason.

(2) The utility model discloses a set up disinfection fluorescent tube, air distributor and blast air subassembly, when using, the user can be through opening disinfection fluorescent tube and air-blower for the device can realize drying and the disinfection to the device under the effect of disinfection fluorescent tube and air-blower, thereby reduces the influence of inside bacterium when using once more to the device, and then the effectual result of use who guarantees the device.

Drawings

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the overall internal structure of the present invention;

In the figure: 1. a box body; 2. a support base; 3. a box door; 4. a wind distribution plate; 5. a partition plate; 6. a rotating shaft; 7. a turntable; 8. a drive shaft; 9. a dial plate; 10. an observation window; 11. opening the handle; 12. mounting a plate; 13. sterilizing the lamp tube; 14. an exhaust duct; 15. a first control valve; 16. a blower; 17. an air duct; 18. drying the part; 19. a second control valve; 20. a culture dish placing groove; 21. and (7) a ventilation through hole.

Detailed Description

The technical solution in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention.

As shown in fig. 1-4, the utility model provides a technical solution: a biological gene culture device comprises a box body 1 and a supporting base 2 arranged at the bottom of the box body 1, wherein a box door 3 is arranged at one side of the box body 1, air blowing components are arranged at two sides of the top of the box body 1, air distribution plates 4 are arranged at two sides of the inner wall of the top of the box body 1, cavities are arranged in the air distribution plates 4, a plurality of air-permeable openings are arranged at the bottom of the air distribution plates 4, a partition plate 5 is arranged at the upper position of the bottom of the inner side of the box body 1, a rotating shaft 6 is arranged at the middle position of the top of the partition plate 5, the top of the rotating shaft 6 is connected with the inner wall of the top of the box body 1 through a bearing, a rotating disc 7 is arranged at the outer side of the rotating shaft 6, a driving shaft 8 is arranged at the bottom of, the middle position of the driving shaft 8 is provided with a poking disc 9, and one side of the poking disc 9 penetrates through the outer wall of the box body 1.

The box door 3 is arranged at the top of the partition plate 5, the observation window 10 is arranged in the middle of the box door 3, and the opening handle 11 is arranged on one side of the box door 3.

The inner wall of the box body 1 is provided with mounting plates 12 on two sides, one side of the mounting plate 12 away from the inner wall of the box body 1 is fixedly connected with a disinfection lamp tube 13, and the disinfection lamp tube 13 is an ultraviolet lamp tube.

The air outlet has all been seted up to the above-mentioned position in box 1 both sides bottom, the air outlet all sets up at 5 tops of baffle, air outlet one side is connected with exhaust duct 14, exhaust duct 14 is inside to be provided with first control flap 15.

Two sets of the air blast subassembly is by air-blower 16, tuber pipe 17, dry 18 and second control valve 19, air-blower 16 bottom with 1 top fixed connection of box, tuber pipe 17 one end with 16 air-out ends of air-blower are connected, the tuber pipe 17 other end run through the box 1 with the 4 tops of air distributor are connected, dry 18 with second control valve 19 all sets up inside tuber pipe 17, just dry 18 sets up inside tuber pipe 17 is close to 16 one side of air-blower, dry 18 inside active carbon that adopts as the filler.

Carousel 7 is provided with the multiunit, multiunit 7 intermediate position all be provided with 6 assorted through-holes of pivot, and multiunit carousel 7 all through the through-hole with 6 outer walls of pivot are connected, and the multiunit 6 one side of pivot are kept away from to carousel 7 all is provided with culture dish standing groove 20, a plurality of sets of ventilative through-hole 21 have all been seted up to culture dish standing groove 20 bottom, just ventilative through-hole 21 all runs through carousel 7 bottom.

The working principle is as follows: when the device is used, a user can rotate the dial plate 9, and then under the driving of the dial plate 9, the driving shaft 8 can drive the rotating shaft 6 to rotate, and further under the driving action of the rotating shaft 6, the user can take out the culture dishes inside the culture dish placing grooves 20 at different positions at the top of the rotating plate 7 according to the self requirement without taking out the whole rotating plate 7, so that the device is convenient to use, and the culture dishes at other positions of the rotating plate 7 are prevented from being polluted, further after the device is used, the user can open the sterilizing lamp tube 13 and the air blower 16, simultaneously open the first control valve 15 and the second control valve 19, further realize the sterilizing work inside the device under the action of the sterilizing lamp tube 13, and after the external wind is dried through the drying piece 18 under the action of the air blower 16, the air distribution plate 4 is injected through the air pipe 17, then the drying treatment is carried out on the interior of the device through the air distribution plate 4, and then the device can be dried and sterilized under the action of the sterilizing lamp tube 13 and the air blower 16, so that the influence of internal bacteria on the reuse of the device is reduced.

Although embodiments of the present invention have been shown and described, it will be appreciated by those skilled in the art that changes, modifications, substitutions and alterations can be made in these embodiments without departing from the principles and spirit of the invention, the scope of which is defined in the appended claims and their equivalents.
